movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Closed position, arms often held high, lead's right hand on follow's back
movement_profile.posture: Upright, constant bounce on the balls of the feet

signature_moves.description: Non-planted foot kicks on each slow beat, quicks done in tandem
signature_moves.name: Cross Kicks

signature_moves.description: Step and hold with non-planted leg extended and planted leg bent
signature_moves.name: Shag Dips

music_profile.sound_description: Fast-paced jazz music with a driving, consistent beat suitable for high-energy dancing.

teaching.level_notes: Requires high cardiovascular endurance due to the fast tempo (185-250+ BPM).
